arguments.summary: The available latest-10-Q extracts establish the relevant filing periods for ANET and NVDA, but their truncated excerpts do not contain country revenue, restricted-product, or Taiwan/Asian manufacturing-dependency disclosures. MU and META latest 10-Q documents were identified but not retrievable within this task’s remaining turn. Therefore direct issuer-level trade-policy transmission cannot be quantified from the supplied filing evidence.

claims.text: Arista’s latest available 10-Q is for the quarter ended June 30, 2026. Its retrieved extract says Arista has wholly owned subsidiaries in North America, Europe, Asia and Australia, which documents international operations but does not quantify China revenue, restricted products, or Asian manufacturing dependency in the available extract.

NVIDIA’s latest available 10-Q is for the quarter ended July 26, 2026; the retrieved extract supplies financial statements and identifies later risk-factor sections, but the available truncated extract contains no country-revenue, restricted-product, or Taiwan/Asian manufacturing-dependency quantification.

The SEC submissions identify Micron’s latest 10-Q filed June 25, 2026 (period ended May 28, 2026) and Meta’s latest 10-Q filed July 30, 2026 (period ended June 30, 2026). Their document contents were not available in the supplied evidence, so no filing-based direct-exposure conclusion can be made for either issuer.

If a policy action covers products, customers, suppliers, or manufacturing jurisdictions relevant to an issuer, it could transmit through sales, supply availability, compliance costs, or demand over 21/63 sessions; available filings do not provide the issuer-specific inputs needed to quantify that channel.

gaps.description: Complete latest 10-Q risk-factor, geographic-revenue, customer, product, supplier and manufacturing disclosures for MU and META were not retrieved; their direct trade-policy exposure is unquantified.
The supplied ANET and NVDA 10-Q extracts are truncated and cannot support a negative conclusion about disclosures outside the extract, nor quantify China/restricted-product/Taiwan exposure.
No dated policy text maps a specific current trade restriction to issuer products, countries, counterparties, or financial impact.

assumptions: A geographic-operational footprint alone is not treated as quantified revenue, manufacturing, or restricted-product exposure.
A policy scenario requires a separately documented mapping from covered policy terms to company operations.
arguments.counter_thesis: International operations may be diversified or immaterial to a particular policy action; absent quantified issuer disclosures and covered-product mapping, a direct near-term transmission claim would be speculative.

review_conditions.description: Review when complete current issuer filings or earnings materials quantify China/cross-border revenue, restricted products, Asian/Taiwan manufacturing reliance, or a policy-linked shipment/supply impact.

question_effects.reason: Available extracts document filing recency and ANET’s international subsidiaries, but do not quantify direct exposure; MU/META filing contents and full ANET/NVDA disclosure sections remain unavailable.
